description.v: HerSpace designs, manufactures, deploys and operates modular workforce housing for industrial workers near manufacturing clusters. Products include worker dormitories (50-1000+ beds), HerSpace Secure (women's housing with biometric access and female wardens), family units for supervisors, and site offices/welfare blocks.
description.note: Company website confirms full product range. NOT aerospace composites/DFR.

employee_estimate.note: No employee count found. Company website has no careers page visible.
